size.note: Newman's Birds gives 53 cm on the Red-crested Korhaan page.

summary: The colour key says the rufous crest is not normally visible and is erected from the nape in courtship, and that the upper parts are brown with creamy arrow shapes. Newman’s page uses the name Lophotus ruficrista. This file keeps Lophotis ruficrista. The description paragraph on that page is the Temminck’s Courser account, also printed on the Temminck’s Courser page, so it was not used. Status and months are unset. The Kemp paper name Redcrested Korhaan and the code RB were left unchanged.
